features.feature: Audit current locks, Store replacement, and execution receipts before claiming a RED; preserve already-correct baselines and bind each genuine failure to the pre-fix source hash.
Execute Story 3A ledger integrity before Story 3B runtime evidence integrity, with no authoritative Story 2 or Story 1 path before the prerequisite is accepted.
Use one canonical local-filesystem fenced writer with schema epoch, minimum writer capability, session, lease, and monotonic fence token.
Allocate collision-resistant durable record IDs independently of mutable array length.
Make idempotent retry return the original semantic record IDs and receipt ID with zero duplicate rows or recursive receipts.

Define and test the durable local-filesystem crash boundary: temp write, file fsync, atomic rename, directory fsync, recovery, stale-writer refusal, unsupported NFS or corruption refusal, and no nested-lock deadlock.

Provide a shared schema-neutral multi-record transaction for Finding, route, assessment, mandatory-repair, expiry-policy, deferral, supersession, baseline, re-attestation, manifest, and receipt persistence without interpreting downstream semantics.
Compare exact persisted record bytes, record IDs and hashes, current chain head, predicate digest, and prior ledger digest under one fence; any conflict or callback refusal writes no semantic rows.
Implement the complete signed FindingLedgerReceipt field and trust contract.
Append LegacyFindingIdentityBinding exactly once on first read or backfill while preserving historical Finding bytes and failing closed on tuple, hash, or record-ID collision.

Atomically persist FindingAssessmentProposal plus one non-recursive ledger receipt and expose the shared verifier or query path that rejects wrong authority or signature, altered exact-union payload, missing receipt, stale or expired proposal, and proposal-to-final divergence.
Prove mandatory-repair classify and close plus expiry-policy records are append-only, unique, idempotent, and never half-visible with their manifest references.

Create a signed content-addressed RuntimeEvidenceReceipt binding source head and material, build and execution policy and commands, outputs, redacted allowlisted environment, artifacts, toolchain, producer, and trust metadata.
Persist append_runtime_receipt through the exactly-once ledger path and prove crash and replay return the same runtime record and ledger receipt IDs.

Reject build-in-progress, pre/during/post artifact mutation, source or command or environment drift, blob tamper, symlink or realpath escape, unsupported trust, revoked or expired keys, and secret leakage.
Register atomic persistence separately from gate-eligible runtime evidence so persisted candidate, route, baseline, historical, and receipt bytes never become semantic lifecycle authority.

Expose a signed deterministic protected read-only query for ledger, CAS, idempotency, migration, and runtime scorecard inputs with no protected path leakage and fail-closed incomplete or tampered rows.
Reject reverse imports from Story 2 or Story 1 and preserve the schema-neutral public callback and query boundary.
Mechanically prove B-03b7 and B-e6d9 cannot advance into implementation before B-fe8f is DONE, matching the original strict dependency-order acceptance claim.
Create gate-consumable RED evidence at the pre-fix anchor and an explicit RED-to-GREEN relation, rather than relying only on terminal prose or a mutable test file.

Provide rollback and kill-switch coverage that stops unsafe new writes or use, preserves readable committed history, refuses unsupported newer epochs, and restores the previous supported mode without data loss.
Integrate the RuntimeEvidenceReceipt into a real build or execution adapter entrypoint rather than demonstrating only a core helper in the Story smoke.
Do not implement canonical defect judgment, detector classification, historical recall, applicability verdicts, route semantic authority, or lifecycle gate enforcement in Story 3.
features.excluded_by: Owned by B-03b7 or B-e6d9; Story 3 is schema-neutral persistence and runtime evidence only.
